description: This file is a shell script that defines a set of tests for a Git extension or helper, specifically for remote 'connect' operations, using functions from an external library './test-lib.sh'. It sets up Git repositories, performs clone and pull operations, and verifies behavior with a fake git-daemon.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a label and a shell command block to execute.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Simulates advancing the Git internal timer to ensure unique timestamps for commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs, typically for verifying test results.
